channel.description: 安装git linux 下安装 1# Debian 下安装git 2apt install -y git 3 4# 验证 5git -v 6 7# 以下输出为正常安装 8git version 2.47.3 github配置 1# ssh-keygen -t rsa -b 4096 -C "o0oo00ooo@example.com" 2ssh-keygen -t rsa -b 4096 -C "your_email@example.com" 3 4# 以下内容无脑回车 5Generating public/private rsa key pair. 6Enter file in which to save the key (/root/.ssh/id_rsa): 7Enter passphrase for "/root/.ssh/id_rsa" (empty for no passphrase): 8Enter same passphrase again: 9Your identification has been saved in /root/.ssh/id_rsa 10Your public key has been saved in /root/.ssh/id_rsa.pub 11The key fingerprint is: 12SHA256:ot9lilcigrCwuD1I0x/RFRfHGPrXjJ/LiGegnJopMUA o0oo00ooo@example.com 13The key's randomart image is: 14+---[RSA 4096]----+ 15| ..+=. | 16| E .o... | 17| . . .. | 18|o . . . . + | 19|o+... o S . o o | 20|+o...=... ... . .| 21|.+. o.+..o= . o | 22|o o + o+B .oo .| 23| . +=+ .o. o | 24+----[SHA256]-----+ 25 26# 在github上配置刚刚生成的key 27 28# 配置git 29git config --global user.name "xxoo" 30 31# 设置全局邮箱 32git config --global user.email "o0oo00ooo@126.com" 使用 fastgit（国内镜像，不好用） 1bash# 临时使用 2git clone https://hub.fastgit.org/bats-core/bats-core.git 3 4# 全局设置 5git config --global url."https://hub.fastgit.org/".insteadOf "https://github.com/" 6 7# 恢复 8git config --global --unset url.https://hub.fastgit.org/.insteadof
